name: Burn After Bliss
overview: Lin Yuan, a well-behaved and gentle intern, ends up in a one-night stand with a stranger entering the wrong room in a drunken stupor. The next day, she hastily runs away in fear of being held responsible, thinking she will never see him again. However, she bumps into him at the hospital. Dressed in a white shirt, he shoots her an arrogant and aloof look...
